pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pOwner-bound FE generator whose plug platform and stable boards determine valid operation and instability.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Bind and insert a Locator Module.$p2. Build the square of plugs, base blocks and outside wall.$p3. Insert stable analysed boards in plugs.$p4. Provide output space or a battery to receive generated energy.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pBelow the stabilization threshold the owner must be nearby in the same dimension. A bound module is not a replacement for a valid structure.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:multiblocks/locator)Locator platform diagram$()
